mapper.select:
SELECT IM.PRODUCT_CODE AS "PRODUCT_CODE", IM.ITEM_CODE AS "ITEM_CODE", IM.ITEM_NAME AS "ITEM_NAME", IM.HS_CODE AS "HS_CODE", IFM.FILE_NAME AS "ITEM_IMG" FROM ITEM_MST IM
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT X.COMPANY_CODE, X.ITEM_CODE, X.FILE_NAME FROM ( SELECT F.COMPANY_CODE, F.ITEM_CODE, F.FILE_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY F.COMPANY_CODE, F.ITEM_CODE ORDER BY F.FILE_SEQ ) AS RN FROM ITEM_FILE F WHERE F.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} ) X WHERE X.RN = 1 ) IFM ON IFM.COMPANY_CODE = IM.COMPANY_CODE AND IFM.ITEM_CODE = IM.ITEM_CODE
WHERE IM.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND IM.PRODUCT_CODE = #{PRODUCT_CODE}
ORDER BY IM.ITEM_CODE

SELECT PL.PRODUCT_CODE AS "PRODUCT_CODE", PL.PRODUCT_NAME AS "PRODUCT_NAME", PL.PRODUCT_NAME_ENG AS "PRODUCT_NAME_ENG", PL.FLOWCHART_COMMENT AS "FLOWCHART_COMMENT", TO_CHAR(PL.CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "CREATE_DATE" FROM PRODUCT_LINE PL WHERE PL.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND PL.PRODUCT_CODE = #{PRODUCT_CODE}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT_LINE ( PRODUCT_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, PRODUCT_NAME, PRODUCT_NAME_ENG, FLOWCHART_COMMENT, CREATE_DATE, CREATE_BY, UPDATE_DATE, UPDATE_BY ) VALUES ( #{PRODUCT_CODE}, #{COMPANY_CODE}, #{PRODUCT_NAME}, #{PRODUCT_NAME_ENG}, #{FLOWCHART_COMMENT}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{CREATE_BY}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{UPDATE_BY} )

INSERT INTO FLOWCHART_FILE ( FLOWCHART_CODE, FILE_SEQ, COMPANY_CODE, FILE_PATH, FILE_NAME, ORIGIN_FILE_NAME, CREATE_DATE, CREATE_BY, UPDATE_DATE, UPDATE_BY, REALFILE ) VALUES ( #{PRODUCT_CODE}, NEXTVAL('flowchart_file_s'), #{COMPANY_CODE}, 'POSTGRESQL', #{FILE_NAME}, #{ORIGIN_FILE_NAME}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{CREATE_BY}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{UPDATE_BY}, #{REALFILE} )
mapper.select: SELECT FILE_NAME AS "FILE_NAME", FILE_PATH AS "FILE_PATH", ORIGIN_FILE_NAME AS "ORIGIN_FILE_NAME", FILE_SEQ AS "FILE_SEQ" FROM FLOWCHART_FILE WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND FLOWCHART_CODE = #{PRODUCT_CODE} ORDER BY FILE_SEQ

SELECT REALFILE AS "REALFILE", ORIGIN_FILE_NAME AS "ORIGIN_FILE_NAME", FILE_NAME AS "FILE_NAME", FILE_PATH AS "FILE_PATH", FILE_SEQ AS "FILE_SEQ" FROM FLOWCHART_FILE WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND FLOWCHART_CODE = #{PRODUCT_CODE} AND FILE_SEQ = CAST(#{FILE_SEQ} AS INTEGER)
SELECT PRODUCT_CODE AS "CODE", PRODUCT_NAME AS "NAME" FROM PRODUCT_LINE WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} ORDER BY PRODUCT_CODE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ITEM_FILE ( ITEM_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, FILE_SEQ, FILE_NAME, ORIGIN_FILE_NAME, FILE_EXTENSION, CREATE_DATE, CREATE_BY, UPDATE_DATE, UPDATE_BY ) VALUES ( #{ITEM_CODE}, #{COMPANY_CODE}, NEXTVAL('item_file_s'), #{FILE_NAME}, #{ORIGIN_FILE_NAME}, CASE WHEN POSITION('.' IN REVERSE(#{ORIGIN_FILE_NAME})) > 0 THEN LOWER(SUBSTRING(#{ORIGIN_FILE_NAME} FROM '\.([^.]*)$')) ELSE '' END, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{CREATE_BY}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{UPDATE_BY} )
mapper.select: SELECT FILE_NAME AS "FILE_NAME", ORIGIN_FILE_NAME AS "ORIGIN_FILE_NAME", FILE_SEQ AS "FILE_SEQ" FROM ITEM_FILE WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND ITEM_CODE = #{ITEM_CODE} ORDER BY FILE_SEQ
